{{Quote|So, I see the "Lady" Hutt has sent one of her goons, just as we expected. Now you will learn how foolish it is to interfere in CorSec affairs.|Chief Investigator Klusoe to his attacker|<ref name="AED" />}}
[[Chief Investigator/Legends|Chief Investigator]] '''Klusoe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[inspector sergeant]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Lasha Bindari]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Klusoe to prevent further investigation into [[Shalera]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] affairs.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Klusoe.jpg|thumb|Possible depictions of Chief Investigator Klusoe]]
Klusoe was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

Their name is likely a nod to the bumbling Inspector Clouseau from the Pink Panther film franchise.
